description: Synthetic Bridge-style decisions, approved specifications, assumptions, and relevance labels. Contains no customer or production content.

corpus.title: Retry transient payment failures
corpus.summary: Use exponential backoff with three attempts for retryable card processor failures; permanent declines are not retried.
corpus.body: Retries require an idempotency key and emit an operator-visible terminal failure.

corpus.title: Make command retries idempotent
corpus.summary: Client command requests carry an idempotency key; reuse with a different request body returns conflict.
corpus.body: The stored request hash and response reference prevent duplicate writes after a timeout or resend.

corpus.title: Enforce PostgreSQL tenant isolation
corpus.summary: Every tenant table uses organization-scoped row-level security and application project checks.
corpus.body: Cross-tenant reads and writes fail closed, including when a caller guesses another project identifier.

corpus.title: Use forward-only schema migrations
corpus.summary: Drizzle metadata and regression coverage accompany every additive PostgreSQL schema change.
corpus.body: Existing rows receive a safe backfill before a new non-null constraint is enforced.

corpus.title: Authenticate inbound webhooks
corpus.summary: Verify provider signatures against the raw request body and reject stale delivery timestamps.
corpus.body: Persist the provider delivery identifier to prevent replay without storing the signing secret.

corpus.title: Keep acceptance authority human
corpus.summary: Agents may recommend options and publish drafts, but only an authorized human accepts consequential decisions or approves specifications.
corpus.body: Agent confidence and automation never substitute for the existing approval policy boundary.

corpus.title: Batch deferred email notifications
corpus.summary: Deferred receipts due for one recipient and project are grouped into a single bounded digest message.
corpus.body: A stable batch key makes retries idempotent while immediate protected-review delivery remains separate.

corpus.title: Resume opted-in Codex sessions after human resolution
corpus.summary: Queue automatic continuation only after every linked blocking question has an accepted human decision.
corpus.body: The worker resumes the exact vendor session without bypassing approvals and the run remains waiting until it reports state.

corpus.title: Persist context snapshot provenance
corpus.summary: Record the exact governed item identifiers returned to an agent for each context retrieval.
corpus.body: Snapshots explain available evidence without storing prompts, transcripts, outputs, or hidden reasoning.

corpus.title: Synchronize bounded GitHub issue context
corpus.summary: Store issue identity, title, state, labels, canonical URL, and explicit guidance links.
corpus.body: GitHub remains authoritative; Bridge does not retain issue bodies, comments, assignees, or credentials.

corpus.title: Synchronize pull request context
corpus.summary: Store pull request identity, title, state, merge status, branches, canonical URL, and explicit guidance links.
corpus.body: No repository source, diff, review comment, or provider credential enters the canonical record.

corpus.title: Export privacy-minimized audit events
corpus.summary: Organization administrators can export bounded audit metadata without question or specification content.
corpus.body: The export records its own audit event and never grants decision authority.

corpus.title: Project portability archive specification
corpus.summary: A versioned JSON download contains project metadata, decisions, complete artifact aggregates, and project audit events.
corpus.body: Independent bounded offsets support large exports; the archive is not a backup or restore format.

corpus.title: Protected specification approval workflow
corpus.summary: Immutable specification versions collect required human reviews before one version becomes approved.
corpus.body: Publishing a new draft never silently replaces the approved version or bypasses required reviewer roles.

corpus.title: PostgreSQL recovery verification runbook
corpus.summary: Restore a backup into a fresh isolated database and verify schema, row counts, tenant policies, and application reads.
corpus.body: The exercise never targets the production database and records only sanitized evidence.

corpus.title: OIDC identity and membership specification
corpus.summary: Validate issuer, audience, signature, expiry, and subject before resolving active organization and project membership.
corpus.body: External identity claims do not silently grant project roles or human approval capability.

corpus.title: Dense embeddings may improve paraphrase recall
corpus.summary: A tenant-scoped vector index could retrieve semantically similar guidance with little lexical overlap.
corpus.body: This remains reversible and unconfirmed until an evaluation shows material quality gain.

corpus.title: Pilot audit retention can be ninety days
corpus.summary: A short reversible retention window may satisfy pilot support needs until owners confirm policy.
corpus.body: No deletion automation is authorized by this assumption.

corpus.title: Bound agent command request rates
corpus.summary: Per-project limits reduce accidental question flooding while preserving human workflows.
corpus.body: The exact deployment threshold remains configurable and observable.

corpus.title: Feature branch context should receive a ranking boost
corpus.summary: An exact branch scope match may be useful when several approved records discuss the same component.
corpus.body: Scope boosts are advisory and cannot change record authority.
